steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Discharge PBA terminals per manual. Replace all parts before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Make sure to disconnect the power plug before servicing.

steps.title: Inspect sub/main harness
steps.body: AC: verify wire connections and contacts between sub and main PBAs. Check for moisture on sub PBA.
steps.sourceExcerpt: AC: verify wire connections and contacts between sub and main PBAs. Check for moisture on sub PBA.

steps.title: AC6 inverter path
steps.body: AC6: check main ↔ inverter PBA harness. Machine may auto-recover — power cycle and retest.
steps.sourceExcerpt: AC6: check main ↔ inverter PBA harness. Machine may auto-recover — power cycle and retest.

steps.title: Comm restored after power cycle?
steps.body: After reconnecting harnesses and power cycle, does washer run without AC/AC6?
steps.sourceExcerpt: After reconnecting harnesses and power cycle, does washer run without AC/AC6?

steps.title: Replace PBA
steps.oemOutcome: Replace main or inverter PBA per fault code.
